ur_traceability.goal: Deterministic simulation testing of CLI pipeline
ur_traceability.evidence: Infrastructure built (interface+mock+harness), but actual pipeline-level testing deferred to Phase 3+. Only DependencyManager injection in Phase 2 scope. No follow-up task tracking.

ur_traceability.goal: Pipeline coverage: publish, EPUB, link validation, dependency tree
ur_traceability.evidence: Only dependency tree (DependencyManager) in Phase 2 scope. Publish, EPUB, link validation deferred to follow-up tasks (Phase 3+) without explicit tracking.

findings.title: UR-002 goal: pipeline-level deterministic simulation testing deferred without follow-up tracking
findings.challenge: UR-002 requires 'детерминированное симуляционное тестирование CLI-пайплайна' — the plan builds harness infrastructure but defers actual pipeline-level testing to Phase 3+ without listing concrete follow-up tasks or TASK-ID references for the deferred coverage (publish, EPUB, link validation).
findings.alternative: Either (a) add a 'Deferred Scope' section listing each pipeline module, the target phase, and expected follow-up task ID/name, or (b) expand Phase 2 scope to include at least one non-DependencyManager integration test proving the harness works for other pipeline stages.
findings.risk: Without explicit follow-up tracking, deferred pipeline testing may become indefinitely postponed or fragmented across uncoordinated tasks. Harness integration value unproven beyond DependencyManager until someone picks it up later. Severity: HIGH, Likelihood: MEDIUM.
findings.artifact_ref: plan.md — Scope: 'Phases 1–2 of the CREATIVE design (TASK-002). Phases 3–6 deferred to follow-up tasks.'

findings.title: UR-002 goal: pipeline coverage incomplete (3 of 4 pipeline modules deferred)
findings.challenge: UR-002 explicitly lists 'публикация, EPUB, валидация ссылок, дерево зависимостей' as the pipeline scope. The plan covers only 'дерево зависимостей' (DependencyManager). Publish, EPUB, and link validation are absent from Phase 2 scope with no concrete follow-up plan or acceptance criteria for when DST coverage is 'complete'.
findings.alternative: Add a 'Deferred Scope' section mapping each deferred module to a specific future task: e.g., 'Phase 3 — Module-level interception for links, cache, publisher (see creative.md §14 Phase 3)'. Track in PLAN's UR-002 reference section.
findings.risk: User expectation is full pipeline DST coverage. A plan covering 1/4 pipeline modules risks expectation mismatch and fragmented implementation across future tasks without coordination. Severity: HIGH, Likelihood: MEDIUM.

findings.title: DstHarness injection point underspecified
findings.challenge: Step 4 says 'Starts with DependencyManager injection (Phase 2 scope)' but doesn't specify HOW DependencyManager receives DstIO — constructor injection? Optional parameter? Setter method? Module-level monkey-patch? The existing DependencyManager likely uses direct node:fs calls; the refactoring pattern is not described.
findings.alternative: Specify the DI pattern explicitly: e.g., 'DependencyManager constructor will accept optional DstIO parameter; when provided, file operations route through dstIO instead of direct node:fs calls. Default behavior (null/undefined dstIO) preserves backward compatibility with existing code.'
findings.risk: Implementer must guess the DI pattern, risking inconsistent approach, excessive refactoring, or a pattern that doesn't compose well with other pipeline modules in later phases. Severity: MEDIUM, Likelihood: HIGH.

findings.title: vi.mock governance checklist referenced but absent
findings.challenge: Plan's Risks section states 'vi.mock governance — checklist tracked via PLAN' but no checklist exists in the plan artifact. Creative design (Section 3) establishes a governance rule that vi.mock is temporary for legacy modules and removed upon DstIO migration, but the plan provides no implementation mechanism.
findings.alternative: Add a governance checklist: (a) inventory current vi.mock usage per module, (b) migration priority order to DstIO, (c) removal criteria and owner per module, (d) gate that prevents new vi.mock on new code.
findings.risk: Without explicit checklist, vi.mock will persist indefinitely as 'temporary' measure, undermining DST determinism guarantees and allowing new vi.mock patterns to proliferate. Severity: MEDIUM, Likelihood: HIGH.

findings.title: Existing TestHelpers integration strategy not addressed
findings.challenge: Creative design Section 12 explicitly defines DstHarness's relationship to existing TestHelpers (coexistence/complement, not replacement). The plan does not mention TestHelpers at all — no coexistence guidance, no migration path, no decision on when to use which.
findings.alternative: Add a brief section: 'TestHelpers continues for isolated unit tests on real FS; DstHarness replaces it for integration pipeline tests requiring determinism. Per-module migration tracked in vi.mock governance checklist.'
findings.risk: Developers may create duplicate test infrastructure, misuse DstHarness for unit tests (losing real FS accuracy), or continue relying on TestHelpers for integration tests (losing determinism). Severity: MEDIUM, Likelihood: MEDIUM.
findings.artifact_ref: plan.md — no mention of TestHelpers; creative.md Section 12

findings.title: Self-tests missing DstHarness integration test
findings.challenge: Step 5 (Self-tests) lists 8 categories — all unit-level (seed determinism, FS roundtrip, HTTP mock, tick clock, PRNG, isolation, readdir sorting, fault injection). No test for DstHarness.getDependencyManager() or any harness-level integration wiring.
findings.alternative: Add: 'DstHarness + DependencyManager integration: create harness with MockDstIO, add test files via addFile, run DM.resolveAll(), verify resolved dependency tree matches expected structure.'
findings.risk: The harness→DependencyManager integration path is untested until Phase 3; a wiring defect (wrong injection point, missing method, interface mismatch) would surface weeks later in a different task. Severity: MEDIUM, Likelihood: MEDIUM.

findings.title: No acceptance criteria / Definition of Done per step
findings.challenge: Five implementation steps lack explicit 'done' criteria. E.g., Step 2 'MockDstIO' — done when all 22 methods compile? All unit tests pass? Error parity verified against RealDstIO? All edge cases covered?
findings.alternative: Add acceptance bullets per step: e.g., 'Step 2 done when: (a) all DstIO methods implemented in MockDstIO, (b) all self-tests pass with 3 seed values, (c) error parity proven by running same test suite against Mock+Real.'
findings.risk: Steps may be considered 'done' prematurely with incomplete implementations, passing hidden gaps to integration phase. Severity: LOW, Likelihood: MEDIUM.

findings.title: Dynamic import bypass deferred without interim testing strategy
findings.challenge: Creative design notes PdfGenerator.findChromePath and SvgGenerator.findChromePath use dynamic import (const { existsSync } = await import('node:fs')) which bypasses DI. Plan acknowledges this but defers to Phase 3 without documenting interim strategy for testing.
findings.alternative: Document interim strategy in plan: 'Until Phase 3 refactor, augment puppeteer vi.mock to stub findChromePath returning a known path, enabling DstHarness tests for PDF/SVG generation.'
findings.risk: If Phase 3 is delayed, PDF and SVG modules remain untestable under DST harness. Severity: LOW, Likelihood: LOW.
findings.artifact_ref: plan.md — Risks section: 'Dynamic import bypass in PdfGenerator.findChromePath — deferred to Phase 3'

schema_envelope.rationale: Two user goals from UR-002 are PARTIALLY covered: pipeline-level deterministic simulation testing (publish/EPUB/link validation) is deferred to Phase 3+ with no follow-up tracking, and pipeline coverage only includes dependency tree. Per DA rules PARTIAL→HIGH→REVISE. Additionally 4 MEDIUM-severity completeness gaps (injection pattern underspecified, vi.mock governance absent, TestHelpers integration missing, no harness integration test) further support REVISE. LOW items are advisory carry-forward.
